definitions.explanation: A large, colorful butterfly of the family Papilionidae, known for its distinctive tail-like extensions on its hindwings.

examples.english: A swallowtail butterfly is flying in the garden.

examples.japanese: アゲハ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{柑橘類|かんきつるい}→柑橘類：15619_kankitsurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧アゲハ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a swallowtail butterfly with beautiful yellow and black patterns.

notes:
アゲハ refers to swallowtail butterflies, one of the most recognizable butterfly families in Japan. The full name is アゲハ⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧, but アゲハ alone is commonly understood.

WRITING:
Written as アゲハ (katakana, most common), {揚羽|あげは} (kanji), or あげは (hiragana).

COMMON SPECIES IN JAPAN:
- ナミアゲハ: Asian swallowtail (most common, found in gardens)
- キアゲハ: Old World swallowtail
- クロアゲハ: black swallowtail

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {揚羽|あげは}{蝶|ちょう} pattern ({揚羽紋|あげはもん}) is a traditional Japanese family crest (⟦{家紋|かもん}→家紋：15366_kamon⟧) associated with the Taira clan. It remains one of the most popular ⟦{家紋|かもん}→家紋：15366_kamon⟧ designs.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧: butterfly (general)
- ⟦{蛾|が}→蛾：05011_ga⟧: moth
